props.content:
=== JSAIOS System Developer Documentation Guide ===
Declarative, Data-Driven System Architecture & Component Documentation
Explore architecture, micro-services, CLI commands, and deployment modes below.

props.title: Developer Documentation Reference
props.placeholder: Search architecture, services, CLI commands, or npm scripts...

items.title: Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters)
items.description: Core kernel (src/kernel/) and engines (src/engines/) remain 100% platform-agnostic with zero dependencies on Node fs, process, Express, or DOM APIs. Driving shells (src/shell/) and driven adapters (src/adapters/) implement ports.
items.codeSnippet: Core Kernel (src/kernel/) <---> Output Ports (IChatSessionStorage) <---> Storage Adapters (LocalStorage / File)

items.title: HoneyKernel Core OS Engine
items.description: Central operating system micro-kernel managing service registration, event bus messaging (EventBus), IPC events, and system lifecycle status.

items.title: JSAIOS Kernel Daemon (jsaiosd)
items.description: Feature-flagged background OS process (config/jsaios.config.json -> daemon.enabled) hosting HoneyKernel, active micro-services, and built-in HTTP/WebSocket IPC gateway on port 3001.
items.codeSnippet: npm run start:daemon  # Launches background jsaiosd OS process

items.title: Headless useSearchableList Controller Hook
items.description: View-agnostic React hook managing text search queries, category pills, column sorting, and pagination math. Shared cleanly across Card Grid and Data Table views.
items.codeSnippet: const { paginatedItems, setSearchTerm, viewMode, setViewMode } = useSearchableList(items, { pageSize: 9 });

items.title: SearchableDataContainer Composite UI
items.description: Generic multi-view container connecting useSearchableList to SearchControlBar, CardGridView, TableView, and PaginationFooter. Supports dynamic view switching between Grid and Table modes.

items.title: JSAIOS Chat Engine
items.description: Interactive multi-turn chat engine featuring sticky system context directives, option flag overrides, turn execution, and pluggable session storage.

items.title: Ollama Service Transport Driver
items.description: Pure HTTP REST API transport driver for local Ollama LLM provider (http://localhost:11434). Supports streaming, thinking mode (--think), context tokens (--ctx), and multimodal image prompts.
items.codeSnippet:
const ollama = new OllamaService('http://localhost:11434');
const models = await ollama.getModels();

items.title: ComfyUI Workflow Transport Driver
items.description: Pure HTTP REST API transport driver for ComfyUI node graph workflows (http://localhost:8188). Supports image/media generation, workflow inspection, and parameter overrides.
items.codeSnippet:
const comfy = new ComfyUIService('http://localhost:8188');
const result = await comfy.generateMedia({ prompt: 'cyberpunk city' });

items.title: GitHub Copilot Service Driver
items.description: Pure HTTP REST API transport driver connecting to GitHub Copilot model endpoints (gpt-4o, claude-3.5-sonnet). Token authorization resolved via config/secrets.json or gh auth CLI.
items.codeSnippet:
const copilot = new CopilotService();
const response = await copilot.generateText({ model: 'gpt-4o', prompt: 'Refactor code' });

items.title: Deployment Mode A: Server / Daemon REST Gateway
items.description: Node.js process runs HoneyKernel and JSAIOSServerAdapter on port 3000/3001. Browser shell communicates over REST fetch() and HTTP token streaming. Keeps API secrets safe on backend.
items.codeSnippet:
npm run start:server  # REST Server (Port 3000)
npm run start:daemon  # OS Daemon jsaiosd (Port 3001)

items.title: Deployment Mode B: Standalone In-Browser Kernel
items.description: HoneyKernel, ChatEngine, and keyless REST service drivers run directly inside the browser tab JS memory. Uses LocalStorageSessionStorage for in-tab persistence.
items.codeSnippet:
npm run dev:browser:local   # Standalone In-Browser Kernel dev server
npm run build:browser:local # Build standalone client web app

items.title: Interactive System Terminal Commands
items.description: Core shell builtins and subcommands available in System Terminal Shell (npm run start:cli). Fully data-driven via config/jsaios.terminal.json manifest.
items.codeSnippet:
help                          # Display system reference
status                        # Display kernel uptime & active services
services                      # List registered AI transport drivers
chat new <name> -p <provider> # Create a new chat session
chat send --temp 0.7 <prompt> # Send prompt to active session

items.title: Developer Quickstart & Command Suite
items.description: Essential npm CLI command scripts for running bootloaders, starting dev servers, executing Vitest unit test suites, and generating modular line health reports.
items.codeSnippet:
npm run start:cli       # Launch Terminal Shell
npm run start:server    # Launch REST Server (Port 3000)
npm run start:daemon    # Launch Kernel Daemon jsaiosd
npm test                # Run 19/19 Vitest unit tests
npm run report:lines    # Generate 100% modular health report
npm run build:browser   # Build Vite web production bundle
